name: Venison
siboNotes: Venison is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated for SIBO. Choose lean cuts and avoid marinades with garlic or onion.
preparationTips: Marinate with FODMAP-friendly herbs like rosemary, thyme, and oregano
Cook to medium-rare to avoid overcooking this lean meat
Season with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Pair with low-FODMAP vegetables for balanced meals
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in iron and B vitamins
Lower in saturated fat than beef
Good source of zinc and phosphorus
